snip.t: (​ ​Steatorrhea​) difficult to flush, weight loss, s/s4 of vitamin deficiencies (peripheral neuropathy, easy\nbruising), Anemia, coagulopathy, hypoalbuminemia, osteopenia​.
Protozoan illnesses, when persistent, can lead to poor weight gain in the young and immunocompromised individuals, weight loss, malnutrition, or vitamin deficiencies.
Other mechanisms: - Malnutrition + vitamin deficiencies - Impaired digestive function (chronic gastric + intestinal mucosal damage + pancreatitis)
